streets.label: Streets, Sidewalks & Transit
streets.description: Transportation and public ways, including streets, sidewalks, transit, biking, and pedestrian safety.

parks.label: Parks, Recreation & Facilities
parks.description: Parks, recreation, public facilities, and shared indoor and outdoor spaces.

env.label: Environment, Health & Safety
env.description: Environmental sustainability, public health, cleanliness, and safety.

community.label: Community & Culture
community.description: Arts, culture, community resources, public services, and neighborhood connections.

youth.label: Youth & Education
youth.description: Ideas focused on young people, education, learning, and youth programs.

other.label: Uncategorized
other.description: Ideas without a recorded committee or a clear cross-cycle theme.

ineligible.label: Not eligible
ineligible.description: Did not meet PB rules, such as capital funding, ownership, cost, or scope requirements.

referred.label: Referred to City staff
referred.description: Was directed to City staff or another process rather than continuing through PB.

underway.label: Already underway by the City
underway.description: The need was already funded, planned, or being addressed by the City.

not_advanced.label: Not advanced
not_advanced.description: Was reviewed but did not move forward to the shortlist.

shortlist.label: Shortlisted
shortlist.description: Was selected for further development or feasibility review but did not reach the ballot.

ballot.label: Made the ballot
ballot.description: Helped shape a proposal that appeared on the PB ballot but did not win funding.

won.label: Inspired a winning project
won.description: Helped shape a ballot proposal that won funding.

review.label: No recorded outcome
review.description: The available data does not say where the idea ended in the PB process.
